errors: No mathematical errors, because there is no mathematics.

The historical statements are the conventional late-18th/early-19th-century mythographic chronology and are not factual history. Examples: Argonauts c. 1250, Thebes c. 1225, Troy c. 1200; the figure of 1,000 ships rounds Homer's Catalogue of Ships (about 1,186); 100,000 men is a traditional estimate. These are consistent with the sources of the time, not slips of the writer.

transcription_corrections: Last line: 'Heroischen Jahre {+Kriege+}[?] wurd[?] an[?] die[?]' more plausibly reads '[In den] Heroischen Jahre[n] ... waren die', continuing on the next page with 'Griechen noch genau so mit einander verbunden'. The interlinear insertion above 'Jahre' is uncertain ('Kriege' is possible).
The insertion mark after 'Völkerschaften' is a caret pointing to the interlinear word 'Griechen' written above, i.e. 'Alle Hellenischen Völkerschaften [der Griechen]'.
'Agamemnon' is a marginal insertion split as 'Agamem-' / 'non' across the line break; the transcription handles this correctly.
The folio number '54' is visible at the top left.
